run_translate_pipeline: run the translate.py module to translate sentences from stdin using a trained XLM transformer model
build_translation_parser: build an argparse parser with translation parameters including beam search, batch size, and language options
test_bleu_evaluation: test the translation output by evaluating BLEU score against a reference file
refactor_beam_search: refactor the translation loop to support beam search decoding with configurable length penalty and early stopping
summarize_translate_main: summarize the main translation function that loads model weights, encodes input, and generates target sentences
